title: POS System  ·  Installation Wizard
s1_desc:
Enter the one-time provisioning token (OTPK) and the Legisell URL.
The image tags are provided by the Legisell owner together with the OTPK.
s1_log_fail: ✗ Provisioning failed. Please check token and URL.
s1_log_done: ✓ Provisioning complete! Proceed to the next step.
s2_desc:
Enter the GHCR credentials provided by the Legisell owner.
These are required to pull the Docker images.
s2_creds_found: ✓ GHCR credentials found in {source} — login fields disabled.
s2_log_skip_login: ⏭ Docker login skipped — using existing credentials.
s2_err_no_creds_for_skip: No GHCR credentials found in ~/.docker. Please uncheck and log in.
s2_err_missing: Please enter username, token, and sudo password.
s2_auth_file_missing: ✗ Docker auth file is missing: {path}. Please run Docker Login again.
s2_auth_file_is_directory: ✗ Docker auth path is a directory: {path}. Please remove or rename the directory and run Docker Login again.
s2_auth_file_directory_not_empty: ✗ Docker auth path is a non-empty directory: {path}. It was not removed automatically for safety.
s2_auth_file_not_file: ✗ Docker auth path is not a regular file: {path}.
s2_auth_file_invalid_json: ✗ Docker auth file does not contain valid JSON: {path}. Detail: {detail}
s2_auth_file_unreadable: ✗ Docker auth file cannot be read: {path}. Detail: {detail}
s2_auth_file_missing_ghcr: ✗ Docker auth file does not contain GHCR credentials: {path}.
s3_log_pulling: (Pulling images — this may take a few minutes …)
s3_no_docker: ✗ ERROR: 'docker' not found. Please install Docker.
s3_kiosk_agent: Install kiosk power agent on this machine
s3_kiosk_agent_hint: Enables the power-off button on the POS login screen to shut this machine down. Only useful on POS terminals — leave unchecked on a server in a rack. Other terminals (browser-only devices) need kiosk-agent/install.sh run separately.
s3_kiosk_agent_ok: ✓ Kiosk power agent installed and running.
s3_kiosk_agent_fail: ✗ Could not install the kiosk power agent ({exc}). The deployment itself succeeded — only the power-off button stays hidden.
s3_clock_sync_ok: ✓ Time synchronisation active — the system clock is kept corrected.
s3_clock_sync_pending: Time synchronisation enabled, still converging (normal right after boot).
s3_clock_sync_fail: ✗ Could not enable time synchronisation ({exc}). The deployment continues, but a drifting clock will later block every licensed feature. Please run `sudo apt install systemd-timesyncd` followed by `sudo timedatectl set-ntp true`.
s3_clock_tz: ✓ Timezone {tz} taken from the host and written to .env.
s3_log_pull_fail: ✗ Image pull failed. Please check the GHCR credentials.
s3_log_fail: ✗ Deployment failed. Please check the log.
s3_log_tip: Tip: sudo docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml logs
s3_auth_file_not_absolute: ✗ POS_DOCKER_AUTH_FILE must be an absolute Linux path: {path}
err_no_docker: Docker is not installed or not in PATH.
err_no_sudo: sudo is not installed or not in PATH.
skip_no_env: .env not found — please run once without --skip-setup first.
s1_chk_already_provisioned: Credentials were already fetched from Legisell (skip provisioning)
s1_log_skip_provision: ⏭ Provisioning skipped — patching changed image tags only …
s1_err_no_env_for_skip: No .env file found. Please run once without the checkbox to complete provisioning.
s1_manifest_header: Latest release tags from manifest.json (as of {date}) — set automatically, please verify:
s1_hint_otpk: One-time activation key provided by the Legisell owner.
s1_hint_url: Full URL of the Legisell Pub-API, e.g. https://api.legisell.de:8443
s1_hint_image_backend: Docker image tag for the backend, e.g. ghcr.io/org/pos-backend:1.2.3
s1_hint_image_frontend: Docker image tag for the frontend service.
s1_hint_image_service: Docker image tag for the image upload service.
s1_hint_image_updater: Docker image tag for the updater sidecar.
s1_hint_image_backup: Docker image tag for the backup sidecar.
s1_hint_deployment_repo: GitHub repo for release notes, format: org/pos-deployment
s1_hint_host_compose_dir: Absolute host path to this directory, e.g. /home/pos-deployment. Required by the updater for self-updates.
s2_hint_token: Personal Access Token with read:packages permission.
s2_hint_sudo: Sudo password of the current user for Docker commands.
s2_hint_backup_user: Username for the Backup Web UI (default: admin).
s1_chk_wsl2: Enable WSL 2 / Docker without Sudo mode
s3_diagnostics_hint: Sets up a local diagnostics and repair tool the customer opens in a browser at http://127.0.0.1:9120/. It checks printers, network, clock and the POS services, and fixes the most common faults without a technician visit.
s3_diagnostics_ok: ✓ Diagnostics system installed — available at http://127.0.0.1:9120/
s3_diagnostics_fail: ✗ The diagnostics system could not be installed: {exc} — the POS still works.
s3_usb_backup: Set up USB backup automount on this machine
s3_usb_backup_hint: Makes a plugged-in USB stick usable as an extra backup target. Only useful on the Docker host — not on browser-only terminals. Without this rule a stick stays invisible on kiosk machines, because no desktop session is there to mount it. Enable it in the POS afterwards under Settings ▸ Backup.
s3_usb_backup_fail: ✗ USB backup automount could not be installed ({exc}). The deployment itself succeeded — you simply cannot register USB targets.
